entries.subject: AC-1 fix direction: reject-on-mismatch
entries.text: Chose reject-on-mismatch (backlog option 1) over resolve-relative-to-canonical-dir. append's _cmd_append will compare os.path.abspath(explicit --file) against os.path.abspath(NEXUS_RELAY_FILE) whenever both are present; on mismatch it refuses with a clear error naming the canonical path instead of silently operating on the cwd-relative one. Rationale: append never creates a file (it reads an existing one and errors 'no such file' otherwise), so the NXS-LOCAL-0021 shadow file was created via a prior relative-path create/append against the worktree cwd, not appended into thin air -- reject-on-mismatch closes that path unconditionally and needs no guess about which directory the caller meant, whereas resolve-relative-to-canonical-dir would still let a wrong relative --file silently open a different, also-wrong file under the canonical dir if its basename happened to exist there. No --file (env-default) and absolute --file matching NEXUS_RELAY_FILE are both unaffected: the compared paths are identical so the mismatch check never fires. Scoped to append only, per the movement's scope-out of every other subcommand.
